limits: Proposed tolerances, not released drawings, inspection results or confirmed OEM tolerances.
Stop face stack = cheek inner face ±0.25 + collar width ±0.10; 70 mm sleeve/ring maximum width assumed 70.10. Confirm both fitted lengths and axial datum.
Link dimension corners propagated at fixed poses; not a coupled tolerance/load/friction simulation.
Historical 6.586 mm comparator uses largest current-pose tolerance effect as a provisional transfer, not a rerun of historical tolerance corners.
0.312 mm thermal allocation = 650 mm ×12e-6/K ×40 K assumed differential, not a thermal solution.

tolerance.unresolved: Core/keeper fit can introduce preload or axial play. Match measured parts/approved shims, verify free gap and available stroke. No assumed preload credit. Supplier must bound densification, shell friction/bloom, dynamic peak and tolerances.

mass.basis: LT29 ledger preserved except replaced pivot candidates. Steel by CAD volume; core0.10kg each allowance. All new mass on body. Connection and oil allocation unchanged.

supplier.manufacturer_reference: Plascore AlTuCore brochure: custom cylindrical ID/OD, approximate strength1000–8000psi and typical55–70% stroke. Family capability only, no application approval.

load_path.option_A: Truck frame → cage/caps and bearing outer race → spherical contact → inner ring axial face → stepped pusher → corrugated core → backing seat → cheek/gussets → crosshead/end webs → rail diaphragms → main rails.
load_path.option_A_status: Shown physical cartridge uses this path; axial impact capability of bearing/housing/caps is NOT accepted. Pin retention and bronze sleeve are not credited as axial catchers.
load_path.option_B: Independent articulated safety link with separate truck-frame and body-frame anchors. Would bypass main pivot bearing/caps. Anchor packaging, effective lever arms, articulation, failure independence and its own end bearings require a new design after engineer selection.
load_path.decision: UNRESOLVED — request running-gear engineer selection before advancing either path toward fabrication.
load_path.hard_stop: No force cap at bottoming or shell/core jam. 85 kN is a target plateau ceiling only; specify credible overload and load factors.
